question: Estimate the cost structure of Indian Premier League (per franchise / team annual).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Franchise fee paid to BCCI (annual): ~₹8-15 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Stadium licensing fees for home games + match-day costs: ~₹15 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Player salaries (cap ₹100 Cr by BCCI rule)
- Support staff (coaches, physiotherapist, analyst, masseur, manager)
- Stadium licensing fees for home games + match-day costs

calculationFlow: - Player salaries (cap ₹100 Cr by BCCI rule): ~₹100 Cr.
- Support staff (coaches, physiotherapist, analyst, masseur, manager): ~₹25-30 Cr.
- Franchise fee paid to BCCI (annual): ~₹8-15 Cr.
- Marketing + brand activations (independent of BCCI): ~₹20-30 Cr.
- Front office + management + ops staff: ~₹10 Cr.
- Stadium licensing fees for home games + match-day costs: ~₹15 Cr.
Total annual operating cost per team: ~₹220-260 Cr.
Per the revenue side (per Q45 of profitability section): revenue ~₹700-800 Cr.
